WITH log_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO public.lead_events (
    lead_id,
    event_type,
    event_category,
    workflow_name,
    status,
    payload,
    created_at
  )
  VALUES (
    {{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.lead_id }},
    'handoffstarted',
    'workflow',
    '05_WF_Human_Handoff_Workflow',
    'success',
    jsonb_build_object(
      'lead_id', {{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.lead_id }}
    ),
    NOW()
  )
  RETURNING id
),
lead_data AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (l.id)
    l.id AS internal_lead_id,
    l.external_primary_id,
    l.crm_contact_id,
    l.crm_deal_id,
    l.name,
    l.phone,
    l.username,
    l.qualification_summary,
    l.consultation_summary,
    l.lead_status,
    l.handoff_status,
    l.source_metadata->>'amo_subdomain' AS subdomain,

    ci.external_conversation_id AS reply_chat_id,
    ci.channel AS reply_channel,

    c.id AS internal_conv_id

  FROM public.leads l
  LEFT JOIN public.channel_identities ci
    ON l.id = ci.lead_id
  LEFT JOIN public.conversations c
    ON c.lead_id = l.id
   AND c.external_conversation_id = ci.external_conversation_id

  WHERE l.id = {{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.lead_id }}

  ORDER BY l.id, ci.is_primary DESC, ci.id DESC
),
chat_history AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(string_agg(msg, E'\n'), 'История пуста') AS history_text
  FROM (
    SELECT sent_by || ': ' || text AS msg
    FROM public.messages
    WHERE lead_id = {{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.lead_id }}
    ORDER BY created_at DESC
    LIMIT 6
  ) sub
)
SELECT * FROM lead_data, chat_history;

BEGIN;

-- 1. Переводим лида в активный handoff
UPDATE public.leads
SET
  needs_human = true,
  handoff_status = 'active',
  current_route = 'handoff',
  active_workflow = '05_WF_Human_Handoff_Workflow',
  recommended_next_step = 'wait_for_human',
  last_status_changed_at = NOW(),
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = {{ $('Генерация summary').item.json.internal_lead_id_ref }};

-- 2. Обновляем последний handoff, если он уже есть
UPDATE public.handoffs
SET
  source_workflow = '05_WF_Human_Handoff_Workflow',
  handoff_reason = '{{ String($('Генерация summary').item.json.handoff_reason || "other").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  summary = '{{ String($('Генерация summary').item.json.handoff_summary || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  status = 'active',
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = (
  SELECT id
  FROM public.handoffs
  WHERE lead_id = {{ $('Генерация summary').item.json.internal_lead_id_ref }}
  ORDER BY created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
);

-- 3. Если handoff ещё не существовал, создаём его
INSERT INTO public.handoffs (
  lead_id,
  source_workflow,
  handoff_reason,
  summary,
  status,
  created_at,
  updated_at
)
SELECT
  {{ $('Генерация summary').item.json.internal_lead_id_ref }},
  '05_WF_Human_Handoff_Workflow',
  '{{ String($('Генерация summary').item.json.handoff_reason || "other").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ String($('Генерация summary').item.json.handoff_summary || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  'active',
  NOW(),
  NOW()
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM public.handoffs
  WHERE lead_id = {{ $('Генерация summary').item.json.internal_lead_id_ref }}
);

-- 4. Событие: handoff активирован
INSERT INTO public.lead_events (
  lead_id,
  event_type,
  event_category,
  workflow_name,
  status,
  payload,
  created_at
)
VALUES (
  {{ $('Генерация summary').item.json.internal_lead_id_ref }},
  'human_handoff_activated',
  'handoff',
  '05_WF_Human_Handoff_Workflow',
  'success',
  '{{ JSON.stringify({
    handoff_reason: $('Генерация summary').item.json.handoff_reason || "other",
    manager_summary: $('Генерация summary').item.json.handoff_summary || "",
    channel: $('Генерация summary').item.json.channel || "",
    chat_id: $('Генерация summary').item.json.chat_id || "",
    activated_at: new Date().toISOString()
  }).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
  NOW()
);

-- 5. Событие: менеджер уведомлён
INSERT INTO public.lead_events (
  lead_id,
  event_type,
  event_category,
  workflow_name,
  status,
  payload,
  created_at
)
VALUES (
  {{ $('Генерация summary').item.json.internal_lead_id_ref }},
  'manager_notified',
  'handoff',
  '05_WF_Human_Handoff_Workflow',
  'success',
  '{{ JSON.stringify({
    channel: $('Генерация summary').item.json.channel || "telegram",
    telegram_chat_id: $('Send a text message').item.json.result.chat.id,
    telegram_message_id: $('Send a text message').item.json.result.message_id,
    notified_at: new Date().toISOString()
  }).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
  NOW()
);

COMMIT;

INSERT INTO public.workflow_runs (
  lead_id, 
  conversation_id,
  workflow_name, 
  trigger_type, 
  status, 
  input_payload_json, 
  started_at
)
VALUES (
  {{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.lead_id }}, 
  {{ $('Загрузить Досье').item.json.internal_conv_id ?? 'NULL' }}, 
  '05_Human_Handoff_Workflow', 
  'sub-workflow',
